column3: # Anti-clickjacking: X-Frame-Options and CSP frame-ancestors are
# header-only. The site is static, with no sign-in or actions to hijack.
# SRI: Google Fonts CSS differs per browser, so it cannot carry a
# hash. The cdnjs highlight.js files do carry SRI.
# CSP header: Pages cannot send it, so the policy is a <meta> tag in
# base.html. TestContentSecurityPolicy in site/site_test.go guards it.
# CSP directives: frame-ancestors only works as a header. The same
# test fails on unsafe-inline, unsafe-eval or any inline style/script.
